title: 7thGARDEN
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Awyn, a gardener devoted to Marie, the young mistress of his estate, wakes the demon Vyrde just as crusader knights purge his village on a bishop's order (VIZ blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates; The Outer Haven review). To save Marie he pledges himself to Vyrde for a demonic sword, not knowing she plans to slay the six angels who rule the world and claim it (blurb; review). A shounen dark fantasy by Mitsu Izumi, on hiatus after eight volumes.
life_message: It suggests that devotion to the people you love can justify defying even holy powers, since good and evil are not clear-cut (review).

delivery.note: One review says the religious order is presented as blind, arrogant and greedy, while the story leaves Vyrde's cause ambiguous too.

winners_losers: Awyn and Vyrde gain power against the church; the religious order loses sympathy. The story is on hiatus, so no final outcome.
to_verify: Strawman call rests on one review (The Outer Haven, volume 1): check later volumes for a fairer angel side.
